subject: Operations
title: Supply Chain vs. Value Chain
description: A fast breakdown of Supply Chain vs. Value Chain for builders.

hook.text: A supply chain moves products. A value chain adds value. Same activities, different lenses.

buildup.text: Michael Porter's value chain focuses on activities inside a firm that create competitive advantage.

discovery.text: The supply chain extends beyond one firm to all partners. The value chain zooms in on one company's operations.

twist.text: You can have an efficient supply chain but a weak value chain if your internal processes don't add customer value.

climax.text: Best companies align both: their internal value chain reinforces the broader supply chain and vice versa.

punchline.text: Move products through the chain. Add value at every step.

quiz.question: Who introduced the value chain concept?
